glossary.name: Net Revenue
glossary.definition: Gross order value less refunds, discounts and tax, recognised on the settlement date.

glossary.name: Active Customer
glossary.definition: A customer with at least one completed order in the trailing 90 days.

glossary.name: MRR
glossary.definition: Monthly recurring revenue: the sum of normalised monthly plan value across non-churned subscriptions.

glossary.name: Churn
glossary.definition: A subscription that has passed its paid-through date without renewal for 30 days.

glossary.name: Order Grain
glossary.definition: One row per order line, not per order header.

glossary.name: Settled Payment
glossary.definition: A payment whose funds have cleared the acquirer and been reconciled against the invoice.

glossary.name: First Response Time
glossary.definition: Elapsed minutes between ticket creation and the first agent reply, business hours only.

glossary.name: Exposure
glossary.definition: The outstanding notional owed by a counterparty, gross of collateral.

glossary.name: Attributed Spend
glossary.definition: Campaign spend assigned to a conversion under the last non-direct touch model.

glossary.name: Delivered Shipment
glossary.definition: A shipment with a carrier-confirmed delivery scan, not merely marked dispatched.

glossary.name: Headcount
glossary.definition: Employees with an active contract on the last calendar day of the period, contractors excluded.

glossary.name: Gross Margin
glossary.definition: Net revenue less cost of goods sold, before operating expense.

policies.name: Personal data is never returned in the clear
policies.rule: Sample values from columns carrying a pii_type are masked to their last four characters wherever they appear, including in quoted record text.

policies.name: Compensation is need-to-know
policies.rule: Salary, national identifiers and equivalent fields are not summarised, aggregated or sampled.

policies.name: The catalog reports, it does not advise
policies.rule: Recommendations to deprecate, grant access, change an owner, alter a definition or restructure a model are decisions for the owning team. State what the records show and who owns the decision.
